title: Amazwi Azinikeleyo Ecaleni Komprofeti
intro: Kwilizwe elikude, isithunywa esihloniphekileyo sajongana nokulahlwa kabuhlungu ngabalawuli belo xesha. Sekunjalo, iqela elincinci lemiphefumlo ezinikeleyo lalimi ecaleni kwesi sicaka sika-Allah, silangazelela ukuphendula ubizo lukaThixo. Ukholo lwabo olungapheliyo lwaluza kwahlula isizwe esinamandla kwaye ekugqibeleni luyoyise imikhosi yokungakholwa.
clues: Sasiliqela elincinci elizinikeleyo, simanyene elukholweni nasenjongweni.
Sasimi ecaleni kwesithunywa esihloniphekileyo esaliwa ziziphathamandla ezinamandla zelizwe labo.
Xa lo mthunywa wabuza wathi, ‘Ngoobani abaxhasi bam ngenxa ka-Allah?’ saphendula ngaphandle kokuthandabuza.
Simcelile lo mthunywa ukuba afune isidlo esivela ezulwini ukuze asinike isiqinisekiso ezintliziyweni zethu.
Phakathi kwabantu belo xesha, abanye bakholwa ngesigidimi sethu kanti abanye bala ngenkani, kodwa uAllah wabomeleza abakholwayo.
Singabantu baseHawwariyyun — abafundi abazinikeleyo baka-Isa, benziwe boyisa ngenkxaso ka-Allah.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
